title: SITE Centers Reports Q3 2026 Results, Net Loss of $5.4 Million
summary: SITE Centers reported a third-quarter 2026 net loss of $5.4 million, or $0.10 per diluted share, versus a $6.2 million loss a year earlier.
body_markdown:
After the quarter ended, the company sold The Maxwell in Chicago for a gross sales price of approximately $15.3 million and its partnership interests in the Dividend Trust Portfolio joint venture for approximately $32.4 million, and announced a special cash distribution of $3.00 per common share payable on Thursday, November 5, 2026. It has agreed to sell The Blocks in Portland, Oregon for approximately $18.2 million, with closing expected by the end of the fourth quarter of 2026, though it said no assurance can be given that the sale will occur. SITE Centers has also notified the New York Stock Exchange of its plan to voluntarily de-list its common shares prior to the commencement of trading on Friday, December 4, 2026, after which it expects them to trade in the over-the-counter market on the OTCID Basic Market.


**What to watch next:** SITE Centers pays its special cash distribution of $3.00 per common share on Thursday, November 5, 2026.
